This vignette gives a lightweight introduction to the main interface of
`CTTB`. The package estimates Lee-style trimming bounds and
covariate-tightened trimming bounds for treatment effects under endogenous
sample selection.

## Main function

The main entry point is `CTTB()`.

```{r eval = FALSE}
out <- CTTB(
  data = your_data,
  Y = "Y",
  D = "D",
  S = "S",
  X = c("X1", "X2", "X3"),
  LeeBounds = TRUE,
  aggBounds = TRUE
)
```

## Output methods

```{r eval = FALSE}
print(out)
summary(out)
plot(out)
```

## Included data

The package ships with three example datasets:

- `simData`
- `blattman_replic`
- `santoro_replic`

Please see the help pages for the function and datasets for details.
